items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: we had half of Paul Whiteman's original band in there, for that matter, Pingatore and Joe Tardoe, Curt Deiderly on the violin.

ctx.x: That was quite an era then, those great musicians.

Well, at that time, also, I went in and did the Paul Whiteman Hour, and we had half of Paul Whiteman's original band in there, for that matter, Pingatore and Joe Tardoe, Curt Deiderly on the violin. And we had Abe -- the arranger
and conductor for Paul Whiteman. (Len Osser, Abe something.
